metadata.question: Through the months of December 2018 and January 2019, did northern part of Madagascar (between latitude of -12 to -15) recieve less rain than the long-term average for the same two-month period from 2000 to 2019?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about rainfall comparison between a specific period (Dec 2018-Jan 2019) and the long-term average for the same period from 2000-2019 in northern Madagascar. Key elements: - Location: Northern Madagascar (latitude -12 to -15) - Time period 1: Dec 2018 + Jan 2019 (2 months) - Time period 2: Same 2-month period (Dec+Jan) from 2000-2019 (20 years) - Comparison: Is the rainfall less than long-term average? For rainfall data, I'll use CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) which is available in GEE as "UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY". Strategy: 1. Define the region as a rectangle between latitudes -15 to -12 (covering northern Madagascar) 2. Get CHIRPS data for: - Target period: 2018-12-01 to 2019-01-31 - Historical baseline: Dec-Jan periods from 2000-2019 3. Calculate total precipitation for each period 4. Compare if target period is less than historical average Data quality checks: - Check if collections are empty (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist after processing (C2) - Validate calculations are reasonable (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define region (northern Madagascar between latitude -12 to -15) const region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([43, -15, 50, -12]); // Madagascar longitude approx 43-50E // 2. Get CHIRPS precipitation data const chirps = ee.ImageCollection("UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY"); // Target period: Dec 2018 + Jan 2019 const targetPeriod = chirps .filterDate('2018-12-01', '2019-01-31') .filterBounds(region); // Historical baseline: Dec-Jan periods from 2000-2019 const historicalPeriods = ee.ImageCollection(ee.List.sequence(2000, 2019).map(function(year) { const start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 11, 1); // December (month 11 in 0-based) const end = ee.Date.fromYMD(ee.Number(year).add(1), 1, 31); // January next year return chirps .filterDate(start, end) .filterBounds(region) .sum() .set('year', year); }).flatten()); // Check if collections are empty const targetCount = targetPeriod.size().getInfo(); const historicalCount = historicalPeriods.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Target period images: ${targetCount}`); console.log(`Historical periods: ${historicalCount}`); if (targetCount === 0 || historicalCount === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate total precipitation for target period const targetPrecip = targetPeriod.sum(); // Calculate historical average const historicalAvg = historicalPeriods.mean(); // Get pixel counts to check for valid data const targetCountPixels = targetPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const historicalCountPixels = historicalAvg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Target valid pixels: ${targetCountPixels}`); console.log(`Historical valid pixels: ${historicalCountPixels}`); if (targetCountPixels === 0 || historicalCountPixels === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Calculate mean precipitation values const targetMean = targetPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const historicalMean = historicalAvg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Target period mean: ${targetMean?.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`Historical mean: ${historicalMean?.toFixed(2)} mm`); // Validate calculations if (targetMean === null || historicalMean === null || isNaN(targetMean) || isNaN(historicalMean) || targetMean < 0 || historicalMean < 0) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare and determine answer if (targetMean < historicalMean) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
